steps.name: QuriQuriCurriRing (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Adkina] in the “Valley of the Dragon”, defeat [The Oblivious Curiring] in “Phobos” and obtain the <Observant Curiring>. Then report to [Adkina] in “Dragon Valley”.

lines.text: (On a warm, sunny afternoon, the Valley of the Dragon seems to be busy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina, you look busy.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Does it look like that? If that's the case for you, then you must be really busy.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Soon, new phantom beasts will be born in this valley. So, we are making many preparations.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: First, I cleaned it up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were cleaning without a broom?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Haha, you were thinking of general cleaning. The way I do it is a little different.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I return to my original self and fly up into the sky. And with the flap of its wings, it spreads the energy given by the goddess throughout Adrika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. It was a dragon.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Sometimes I feel awkward when I go back to my real self. I'm used to this now, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can do to help? It's hard to just rest... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You always have time for others. Ah, I remembered one thing.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You must have seen Curialing in the Phobos area, right? Curirings are originally the evolved children of the Freeling species, ordinary creatures in our world.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Because it was a creature loved by God in the beginning, it changed into various forms. Surprisingly, I seem to be easily influenced by my surroundings.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A child who likes money can become very worldly, just like a person... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Qiri Ring was originally just an ordinary Free Ring. Maybe someone took him in because he thought he was cute, or maybe he fell into the cracks of the demon world and became a demon after living there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So is it possible to make it go back to its original form?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It is possible if the energy of the place is stronger than the energy of the demonized place. Ah, that will work.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The time when phantom beasts are born is full of clear and clean energy in Adrika. If we bring Curiring to stay here, we might be able to escape from demonization.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s curing… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Then, rescue Kyuriling, who can often be seen in Phobos, and bring her to him.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Now, take this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's like a magic bag that phantom beasts like. God likes to include animals that he cares about. Even a big child like Sequentia won't be seen once he gets in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's an amazing thing.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Curiring will also be guided by the mysterious energy and will enter on its own. Let's just bring about 20 of them and check them out, and then bring them back later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then I'll go pick up Qiriling.

steps.name: Curicuricurialing (2)
steps.objective: In “Rosengarten”, defeat [Calm Curiring] and [Idol Curiring] to obtain <Rescued Curiring> and <Hungry Curiring>. Then report to [Adkina] in “Dragon Valley”.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You worked hard. Aren’t the Qiling children fierce?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I got scolded because he kept running towards me as if he was being cute rather than being fierce.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Freeling species are like that, but these kids are like that because they are frustrated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Maybe it's because you're heavily influenced by dream demons, but you're not affected by that charm.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: What does Curiring say? Yes, yes. what? Aren't we beautiful and cute?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hehe, Curiring is saying the exact same thing as Veled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see Beled saying something like that to Adkina as well.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Haha, it seems like the standards of beauty that dreamers have are definitely different. But why does it seem so difficult?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like a lot of space has been saved because of the magic handle, but I guess the weight is unavoidable. It's quite heavy to carry dozens of Qirilings.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I see. I'm sorry. I feel like I forgot to mention it. Uh, curing? Why are you doing that?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes, yes. Curing. Are you coming? Keep talking.
(The Curirings approach Adkina and make the sound ‘Curry, Curie, Curiring’. Adkina reacts to the sound with various expressions.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Curicuri is all I can hear, what are you saying?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Curiring says this.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I can't be the only one in a place like this. I want to see other friends too. Please ask the fool who can't tell the difference between cute and beautiful if he can bring his friends.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: … It's like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This guy, he's asking a fool to take care of him.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I can't believe the Curing Ball stretches so well... . This is my first time knowing this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, can we rescue the other Qurilings as well?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: However, there is something you need to be careful about. Curiring who wanders outside can relieve his demonized state to some extent, but... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Other species are dangerous. So, bring only the children you see who have potential.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you tell them apart?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The goddess will guide you, so put whatever you think is this guy in this bag and bring it to him. This sack will feel less heavy than the sack I gave you earlier.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: These were originally from Cali, but Tremende brought them over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cali? Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hope Mediah is okay...)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Then please hurry up this time. If possible, I want to deal with it before new phantom beasts are born.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I need to check Qiriling's condition and see if she can get along with the new phantom beasts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will come right away.

steps.name: Curicuricurialing (3)
steps.objective: Visit [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.text: (Adkina is checking the status of the Curirings.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It doesn't hurt, so just stay still. This guy! That's right. okay… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, you are here. Good job!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went there. This sack definitely performs well. It's light, sturdy and holds a lot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I was tired from carrying this up the steep valley.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That's what happened when the phantom beasts found a place to hide in the valley. Now give me the bag with the children in it. uh? It's quieter than I thought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I already gave him some beef jerky that I bought at Luman, and he became quiet.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That beef jerky is perfect for kids to eat. It's not to my taste... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, Adkina?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Now, come out. Guys.
(The Curirings come out of the bag and look around. Then, they find the Curirings that came earlier and start playing together.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, it's louder when we talk in groups.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The environment has changed, so it seems like the adjustment period will take a long time. Still, this place is probably better than other places.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's definitely different from what I see in Phobos or other places, perhaps because I came here.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Maybe it's because I feel at ease... . Ah, you… . I have a request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Now is the time for phantom beasts to be born. Phantom beasts are sensitive to the appearance of humans, so your presence may make them unstable.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Even if you are the goddess' errand boy, this is something you can't help. I'm sorry. Could you please go somewhere else for a while instead?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. Then where should I go?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Go to Tartarus and meet Shinik. Go and see that new phantom beasts have been born, and I have brought Qiri-Ling, so if you want to see them, come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik will like it. Then I'll go and tell you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yeah. Come back.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Are there situations where you shouldn't talk to him?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Medea.
(Medea slowly walks out from behind the tree where there were many phantom beasts.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Long time no see, Adkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm fine. Adkina… Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm fine. Otherwise, what's there to do? I'm worried about you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I, I… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I know it didn't happen because you wanted it to. Don't talk about anything else. First, let’s start with Vice… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I, who am not a human, am telling this story. At that time, all the things that were not interfered with because they were human affairs... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I apologize.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's okay. I just hope it doesn't take too long. And please know that.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I don't know how much trust you have in mind, but the longer it is delayed, the greater the burden on the Goddess' errand boy will be.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: And %s, he cares about you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, I will keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yeah... . Then go back before Shinik comes. Since you seem to have bothered Shinik, I will erase your traces.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's not a bother... . So let's go back now. Thank you, Adkina… .
(Medea bows to Adkina and walks away. Adkina smiles lightly as if she is relieved to see Medea.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: There's no need to worry. It seems like these two have become friends... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm bored. I'm bored. I don't even feel like eating today.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, today’s menu is… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvik, it's because I'm really bothered today. If you keep doing that, I’ll change the butler♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hmm. I wonder if there is another butler who can make Shinik's favorite special curry.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wow, Melvic! You've grown a lot. I've grown something this big!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It's all thanks to Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah, it's all thanks to me, right? Oh... . %s, when did you come?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Shinik. Just now.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sniff, sniff. you smell

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Sniff, sniff. I wash myself well... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It smells like it would be very fun♡… I wanted to say that, but the reaction wasn't so good so it became boring. By the way, did Adkina come from an inspirational place?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You already knew.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. Adkina told me to tell Shinik, so I came. What's going on... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Shinik that a new phantom beast was born and that Qiri-Ring was brought in.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Curing?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, Shinik’s eyes are the brightest I’ve ever seen.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Curiring that demons took in and raised?! Where is Curiring now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought you to the Valley of the Dragon. Adkina is raising those children in the Valley of the Dragon... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Wow, that precious Quriring that I saw hundreds of years ago and have never seen before?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If I purify it, will its wings and tail disappear? You can't do that. Should I bring one and raise it myself? I can be as good as the devil.
(There doesn't seem to be any sound in Shinik's ears.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvik, I don't feel like running, but I'm going to run all the way to the Valley of the Dragon!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, then when are you going to eat curry?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now!!
(Shainik takes away the plate Melvik was holding. Then he quickly shoves the food into his mouth.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll be back!
(As soon as the words are finished, Shinik quickly climbs the wall of Tartarus and goes up to Adrika.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'm glad Shinik is feeling better. Thanks to Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What am I… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You seemed a bit depressed about that incident recently, but you seem to be feeling better after going to Cali.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you all for telling us about Curiling.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I hope you will continue to come to Tartarus and create many fun things for us. Now you can't have fun because of most things.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Oh, Shinik, you said you went to Mars recently?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have work to do... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I guess I should go there sometime. I think I need to see P.O. and have a deacon meeting... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, Peonia….)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Oh, now I have to sort out the things that came into the Superhuman Memorial Hall, so I’ll be leaving. See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, Melvik, good work. Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I feel a little strange... . I just need to get some rest. I'm tired because I have a lot of work to do these days.
